credits_text: Every Legend Has A Beginning Based on True Events
other_text: In the early 1800's John Bell moved to Tennessee to start a new life, but as fate would have it all would be lost to terror. In 1820 he became the first person to be murdered by a spirit, calling herself Kate. In 1826 she promised to return in 107 years. She is way overdue.
moderation_notes: Contains themes of supernatural horror and occult elements.
